final: SELECT CAST(MAX(combination_count) AS FLOAT) * 100 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM connected) as percentage FROM (SELECT a1.element, a2.element, COUNT(c.bond_id) as combination_count FROM connected c JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id GROUP BY CASE WHEN a1.element <= a2.element THEN a1.element ELSE a2.element END, CASE WHEN a1.element <= a2.element THEN a2.element ELSE a1.element END)
